title: Replacement exhaust silencing systems for motorcycles (non-original replacement exhaust silencing systems, NORESS), version 2.0.0
scope_summary: Approves non-original replacement exhaust silencing systems (NORESS), complete or as individual components, with regard to the limitation of their sound level when fitted to one or several specified vehicle types. It applies to replacements for vehicles of categories L1, L2, L3, L4 and L5, i.e. mopeds, motorcycles and motor tricycles.
scope_quote: This UN Regulation applies to non-original replacement exhaust silencing systems for vehicles of categories L1, L2, L3, L4 and L5.
applies_to_components: Fibrous absorbent material used in silencers
relation_to_other_regulations: Refers to UN Regulation No. 9 (sound emission of L2, L4, L5 vehicles); a NORESS is a part different from the type fitted when the vehicle was type-approved under it
Refers to UN Regulation No. 41 (sound emission of motorcycles L3); Annex 1 Part A covers NORESS for vehicle types approved according to the 04 series of amendments to UN R41
Refers to UN Regulation No. 63 (sound emission of mopeds L1)
Sound measurement methods are those of Annex 3 to UN R9, R41 or R63; the test vehicle must meet the limits of the appropriate Regulation (+1 dB(A) in motion, +3 dB(A) stationary)
Vehicle categories as defined in the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3)

defined_terms.label: Non-original replacement exhaust silencing system or components of this system
defined_terms.definition: A system of a type different from that fitted to the vehicle on approval or extension of approval, usable only as a replacement exhaust or silencing system.

defined_terms.label: Non-original replacement exhaust silencing system component
defined_terms.definition: One of the various components, in particular the exhaust manifold, silencer proper, expansion chamber and resonator, which together form the exhaust silencing system.

defined_terms.label: Non-original replacement exhaust silencing systems of different types
defined_terms.definition: Silencing systems differing significantly in trade names or marks, material characteristics, shape or size, operating principles of a component, or combination of components; a change in coating is not a change of type.

defined_terms.label: Non-original replacement exhaust silencing system (NORESS) or component thereof
defined_terms.definition: Any part of the exhaust silencing system intended for use on a vehicle other than a part of the type fitted when the vehicle was type-approved under UN R9, R41 or R63.

defined_terms.label: Approval of a NORESS or component(s) thereof
defined_terms.definition: Approval of the whole or a part of a silencing system adaptable to one or several specified vehicle types, as regards the limitation of their sound level.

defined_terms.label: Vehicle type
defined_terms.definition: Vehicles not differing in engine type, drive train, or number, type and arrangement of exhaust silencing systems.

defined_terms.label: Rated engine speed
defined_terms.definition: The (highest) engine speed at which the engine develops its rated maximum net power as stated by the manufacturer.

applicability_hints: Applies only to non-original (aftermarket) exhaust/silencing parts of a type different from the OE system fitted at vehicle approval; OE-type replacement parts are not NORESS
Individual parts can be approved on their own: exhaust manifolds (headers), silencers/mufflers/end cans, expansion chambers and resonators all fall under it
Covers mopeds (L1, L2) and three-wheelers/quadricycle-like L4/L5 as well as motorcycles (L3), linked to R63, R9 and R41 respectively
Silencers containing fibrous absorbent (packing) material must also meet Annex 3 (asbestos-free, sound level after removal, conditioning)
A change only of coating (zinc, aluminium, etc.) does not create a new NORESS type
Approval is vehicle-type specific: the NORESS must be labelled with the vehicle types for which it is approved, and a component may carry several approval numbers
Pipes and fitting accessories are excluded from the marking requirement but are part of the system description
